text_en: Better the poor walking in integrity than one perverse of speech who is a fool.
text_cn: 穷而行为正直，胜于富而唇舌欺诈。

text_en: Desire without knowledge is not good, and one who moves too hurriedly misses the way.
text_cn: 热诚无谋，诚不可取；步伐匆忙，难免失足。

text_en: One’s own folly leads to ruin, yet the heart rages against the Lord .
text_cn: 人因愚蠢自毁前途；他的心反迁怒上主。

text_en: Wealth brings many friends, but the poor are left friendless.
text_cn: 财富招来许多朋友，穷人却为亲朋所弃。

text_en: A false witness will not go unpunished, and a liar will not escape.
text_cn: 作假见证的人，难免受罚；撒播谎言的人，势必难逃。

text_en: Many seek the favor of the generous, and everyone is a friend to a giver of gifts.
text_cn: 大方的人，人人奉承；好施的人，人都谄媚（chǎn mèi）。

text_en: If the poor are hated even by their kin, how much more are they shunned by their friends! When they call after them, they are not there.
text_cn: 人穷兄弟恨，朋友更远离；谁追求空言，是捕风捉影。

text_en: To get wisdom is to love oneself; to keep understanding is to prosper.
text_cn: 获得明哲的，必爱惜自己；珍惜明智的，必觅得幸福。

text_en: A false witness will not go unpunished, and the liar will perish.
text_cn: 作假见证的人，难免受罚；撒播谎言的人，自趋灭亡。

text_en: It is not fitting for a fool to live in luxury, much less for a slave to rule over princes.
text_cn: 安逸的生活，不适于愚人；奴隶管君主，更是不相宜。

text_en: Those with good sense are slow to anger, and it is their glory to overlook an offense.
text_cn: 明智的人，缓于发怒，宽恕愆（qiān）尤，引以为荣。

text_en: A king’s anger is like the growling of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
text_cn: 君主的盛怒，有如狮子的怒吼；君王的恩惠，有如草上的朝露。

text_en: A stupid child is ruin to a father, and a wife’s quarreling is a continual dripping of rain.
text_cn: 愚昧的儿子，是父亲的灾祸；吵闹的女人，有如屋顶漏水。

text_en: House and wealth are inherited from parents, but a prudent wife is from the Lord .
text_cn: 房屋与钱财，是父母的遗产；贤明的妻子，是上主的恩赐。

text_en: Laziness brings on deep sleep; an idle person will suffer hunger.
text_cn: 懒慢怠惰(dài duò)，使人沉睡；闲荡的人，必要挨饿。

text_en: Those who keep the commandment will live; those who are heedless of their ways will die.
text_cn: 恪守上主诫命的，可保全生命；轻视上主道路的，必自趋丧亡。

text_en: Whoever is kind to the poor lends to the Lord , and will be repaid in full.
text_cn: 向穷人施舍，是借贷于上主；对他的功德，上主必要报答。

text_en: Discipline your children while there is hope; do not set your heart on their destruction.
text_cn: 尚有希望时，应处罚儿子；但不可存心置他于死地。

text_en: A violent tempered person will pay the penalty; if you effect a rescue, you will only have to do it again.
text_cn: 易怒的人，应当受罚：你越宽容，使他越乖戾。

text_en: Listen to advice and accept instruction, that you may gain wisdom for the future.
text_cn: 你应听取劝告，接受教训，使你今后成个明智的人。

text_en: The human mind may devise many plans, but it is the purpose of the Lord that will be established.
text_cn: 人在心中尽可策划多端，实现的却是上主的计划。

text_en: What is desirable in a person is loyalty, and it is better to be poor than a liar.
text_cn: 慷慨为人有利，穷汉胜过骗子。

text_en: The fear of the Lord is life indeed; filled with it one rests secure and suffers no harm.
text_cn: 敬畏上主，使人得生命，满怀敬畏，必无殃无祸。

text_en: The lazy person buries a hand in the dish, and will not even bring it back to the mouth.
text_cn: 懒惰人伸手到食盘，却懒于送回到口边。

text_en: Strike a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; reprove the intelligent, and they will gain knowledge.
text_cn: 你若杖责轻狂人，幼稚者将变明智；你只谴责明智者，他即更明了义理。

text_en: Those who do violence to their father and chase away their mother are children who cause shame and bring reproach.
text_cn: 苛待父亲，迫走母亲的，实是卑贱可耻的儿子。

text_en: Cease straying, my child, from the words of knowledge, in order that you may hear instruction.
text_cn: 我儿，你停止听取教训，就是远离智慧的训言。

text_en: A worthless witness mocks at justice, and the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.
text_cn: 邪曲的见证，戏笑公义；恶人们的嘴，吞食不义。

text_en: Condemnation is ready for scoffers, and flogging for the backs of fools.
text_cn: 体刑是为轻狂人而设，鞭笞是为愚人背而备。
